_comment: Curated owned-channel registry, keyed by SEC CIK. ClearFactor curates it; a channel counts as owned only if the issuer's own website or investor-relations page links to it (verified_by: issuer_site_link) or after manual review. Add rows as {"channel_id": "UC...", "verified_by": "issuer_site_link", "evidence_url": "https://..."}. Deployments can merge a private file via SPLITRISK_OWNED_CHANNELS.
